# `try_make_timestamp_ltz`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Try to create the current timestamp with local time zone from year, month, day, hour, min, sec and (optional) timezone fields. The function returns NULL on invalid inputs.

try_make_timestamp_ltz(date, time[, timezone]) - Try to create the current timestamp with local time zone from date, time and (optional) timezone fields.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_make_timestamp_ltz(year, month, day, hour, min, sec[, timezone])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 6 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 1
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 2
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887, 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 3
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 60);
2019-07-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 4
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(null, 7, 22, 15, 30, 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 5
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(2024, 13, 22, 15, 30, 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 6
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp_ltz, example 7
> SELECT try_make_timestamp_ltz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887', 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```
